"""Independently reopen the fixture correction packet against the current checkout."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess

ROOT = Path('/Users/dylan/.codex/worktrees/native-analytic-frames/shardloom-local-repo')
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
HEAD = '1745c2366d99bb0d7e0864a55382c4d87e40f3f7'
index_path = ROOT / 'docs/benchmarks/evidence/required-execution-resources-2026-10-10.json'
index = json.loads(index_path.read_bytes())
entry = index['synthetic_fixture_review_correction']
packet_path = index_path.with_name(entry['path'])


def digest(path):
    with Path(path).open('rb') as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, 'sha256').hexdigest()


def encoded_digest(value):
    return hashlib.sha256(value.encode()).hexdigest()


def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=ROOT).decode().strip()


assert git('rev-parse', 'HEAD') == HEAD
assert digest(packet_path) == entry['sha256']
packet = json.loads(packet_path.read_bytes())
assert packet['reviewed_head'] == HEAD
assert packet['status'] == entry['status'] == 'passed_local_checks_pending_hosted'
assert packet['performance_claim'] is False
assert packet['whole_process_memory_limit_enforced'] is False
assert packet['original_complete_workflows_rerun'] is False
assert packet['fallback_attempted'] is False and packet['external_engine_invoked'] is False
assert packet['source_hashes'] == packet['protocol']['source_hashes']
assert len(packet['source_hashes']) == 1042
for relative, expected in packet['source_hashes'].items():
    assert digest(ROOT / relative) == expected, relative
for relative, hashes in packet['changed_files'].items():
    original = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', HEAD + ':' + relative], cwd=ROOT)
    assert hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest() == hashes['before_sha256'], relative
    assert digest(ROOT / relative) == hashes['after_sha256'], relative
patch = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'diff', HEAD, '--', *packet['changed_files']], cwd=ROOT).decode()
assert patch == packet['source_patch']


def log_check(record):
    receipt, log = record['receipt'], record['log']
    assert receipt['head'] == HEAD
    assert receipt['direct_child_reaped'] and receipt['process_group_drained']
    assert digest(log['path']) == log['sha256'] == receipt['log_sha256']
    assert encoded_digest(log['text']) == log['sha256']
    return log['text']


checks = {check['name']: check for check in packet['checks']}
assert len(checks) == 17 and set(checks) == set(packet['protocol']['commands'])
for name, check in checks.items():
    log = log_check(check)
    assert check['receipt']['status'] == 'passed' and check['receipt']['returncode'] == 0
    assert check['receipt']['command'] == packet['protocol']['commands'][name]
    if check['rust_test_totals'] is not None:
        matches = re.findall(r'test result: ok\. (\d+) passed; (\d+) failed; (\d+) ignored;', log)
        totals = dict(zip(('passed', 'failed', 'ignored'), (sum(int(row[i]) for row in matches) for i in range(3))))
        assert totals == check['rust_test_totals'] and totals['failed'] == 0
assert re.search(r'^Ran 667 tests in [0-9.]+s\s+OK$', checks['python-optional']['log']['text'], re.M)
assert entry['python_tests'] == 667 and entry['python_existing_skips'] == 0
ci = packet['optional_synthetic_spill_ci_tests']
ci_log = log_check(ci)
assert ci['receipt']['status'] == 'passed'
assert re.findall(r'test result: ok\. (\d+) passed; (\d+) failed; (\d+) ignored;', ci_log) == [
    ('35', '0', '0'), ('13', '0', '0'), ('6', '0', '0')]
for name, cases in packet['verified_regressions'].items():
    log = ci_log if name == 'synthetic-spill-ci' else checks[name]['log']['text']
    for case in cases:
        assert re.search(r'^test (?:\S+::)?' + re.escape(case) + r' \.\.\. ok$', log, re.M), case
assert sum(map(len, packet['verified_regressions'].values())) == 12
assert packet['ci_registration']['report']['status'] == 'passed'
assert packet['ci_registration']['report']['blockers'] == []
support = packet['support']
assert support['results']['status'] == 'passed' and len(support['reports']) == 14
for report in support['reports']:
    if 'text' in report:
        assert digest(report['path']) == report['sha256'] == encoded_digest(report['text'])
assert len(packet['preserved_artifact_sha256']) >= 11
for relative, expected in packet['preserved_artifact_sha256'].items():
    assert digest(ROOT / relative) == expected, relative
for record in packet['preserved_intermediate_checks'].values():
    log_check(record)
failed_finalizer = log_check(packet['initial_finalizer_failure'])
assert 'AssertionError' in failed_finalizer
assert packet['initial_finalizer_failure']['receipt']['status'] == 'failed'
assert 'OK (skipped=5)' in packet['initial_finalizer']['text']
assert digest(packet['initial_finalizer']['path']) == packet['initial_finalizer']['sha256']
summary = {
    'schema_version': 'shardloom.required_resources_synthetic_fixture_inspection.v1',
    'status': 'passed', 'reviewed_head': HEAD,
    'packet': packet_path.name, 'packet_sha256': digest(packet_path),
    'source_files_verified': len(packet['source_hashes']),
    'changed_files_verified': len(packet['changed_files']),
    'source_checks_verified': len(checks), 'python_tests': 667, 'python_skips': 0,
    'optional_spill_ci_tests': 54, 'named_regressions': 12, 'documentation_checks': 14,
    'preserved_prior_artifacts_verified': len(packet['preserved_artifact_sha256']),
    'initial_finalizer_failure_preserved': True,
    'hosted_integration': 'pending', 'original_complete_workflows_rerun': False,
    'inspector': {'sha256': digest(__file__), 'text': Path(__file__).read_text()},
}
output = packet_path.with_name(packet_path.stem + '-inspection.json')
with output.open('x') as stream:
    json.dump(summary, stream, indent=2, allow_nan=False)
    stream.write('\n')
entry['independent_readback'] = {'path': output.name, 'sha256': digest(output), 'status': 'passed'}
index_path.write_text(json.dumps(index, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({key: value for key, value in summary.items() if key != 'inspector'}, indent=2))
